pipeline: PaperOrchestra (Song et al., 2026, arXiv:2604.05018), run by Claude Opus 5.5 with the author's inputs

stages.name: literature
stages.notes: 27 references reused from the v0 paper; 20 new ones verified on their source pages (NeurIPS, ACM/researchr, SMU repository, PMLR, arXiv, RePEc, R documentation, Rothamsted repository, NOAA bibliography, University of Washington copy of Efron 1979, OSF preprint record, Semgrep repository); scholarly APIs (Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, dblp) were blocked by the network proxy and were not used.

stages.name: figures
stages.notes: Two TikZ diagrams (study flow, C1 pipeline); the v5 and v6 diagrams drawn by the author with ChatGPT (GPT-6.2 Sol) from prompts that list every component, checked against decisiones_v5; seven data figures from figures/make_figures.py.

stages.name: sections
stages.notes: v1-v4 written first with the v5 results marked [PENDIENTE]; the marks were filled on 2026-11-27 from experiments/v5_rag/results.csv, confirm_v5.json and results/logs/calls/calls_v5.csv after the main run ended.

stages.name: review and format
checks: every number of Tables 6-8, 9, 10, 13 recomputed from v3_main/results.csv, confirm/results.csv, the calibration summaries, summary_evigate.json and logs/calls (0 mismatches)
independent audit (results/audit/audit_paper.py) of every number, table cell and plotted value, including v5: 610 checks, 609 pass, 1 open (v3 per-case hint coverage)
abstract 199 words with the v5 sentence (MDPI limit about 200)
compiled with the MDPI class: 25 pages, no undefined references, no overfull boxes
review_points_addressed: 'did not lower FAR' stated for these samples
false claims described as 'most', with the per-condition counts
calibration cost reported at list price, client report in parentheses
the early confirmatory look of v4 reported as a deviation
